quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Maria said that she liked her job.
quests.reportedSpeech: Maria said, "I like my job."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Liked' reverses to 'like', and 'she'/'her' reverse to 'I'/'my', since Maria was speaking about herself.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the backshift: past tense in reported speech usually came from present tense in the original words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Maria said that she liked her job." ➔ "Maria said, "I like my job.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Daniel said that he was tired.
quests.reportedSpeech: Daniel said, "I am tired."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was' reverses to 'am', and 'he' reverses to 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Think about what tense and pronoun Daniel would have actually used when speaking about himself.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Daniel said that he was tired." ➔ "Daniel said, "I am tired.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The manager said that the meeting was important.
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said, "The meeting is important."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was' reverses to 'is'; there's no pronoun change needed since the subject is 'the meeting'.
quests.nativeTip: There's no pronoun to reverse here — focus only on the verb tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said that the meeting was important." ➔ "The manager said, "The meeting is important.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Valentina said that she was cooking dinner.
quests.reportedSpeech: Valentina said, "I am cooking dinner."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was cooking' reverses to 'am cooking', and 'she' reverses to 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse both the auxiliary and the pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Valentina said that she was cooking dinner." ➔ "Valentina said, "I am cooking dinner.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Tobias said that his colleagues were working late.
quests.reportedSpeech: Tobias said, "My colleagues are working late."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'His' reverses to 'my', and 'were working' reverses to 'are working'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the possessive and the auxiliary together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Tobias said that his colleagues were working late." ➔ "Tobias said, "My colleagues are working late.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The nurse said that the patient was resting comfortably.
quests.reportedSpeech: The nurse said, "The patient is resting comfortably."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was resting' reverses to 'is resting'; the '-ing' form doesn't change.
quests.nativeTip: Only the tense reverses here — keep the continuous '-ing' form intact.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurse said that the patient was resting comfortably." ➔ "The nurse said, "The patient is resting comfortably.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Sofia said that she had finished her homework.
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia said, "I have finished my homework."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had finished' reverses to 'have finished', and 'she'/'her' reverse to 'I'/'my'.
quests.nativeTip: Past perfect in reported speech usually reverses to present perfect in the original words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia said that she had finished her homework." ➔ "Sofia said, "I have finished my homework.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The technician said that he had already fixed the printer.
quests.reportedSpeech: The technician said, "I have already fixed the printer."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had fixed' reverses to 'have fixed', and 'he' reverses to 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the perfect structure — just move the auxiliary and pronoun back to the original speaker's words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The technician said that he had already fixed the printer." ➔ "The technician said, "I have already fixed the printer.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Backshift Exception
quests.directSpeech: Hassan said that he had locked the door before he left.
quests.reportedSpeech: Hassan said, "I had locked the door before I left."
quests.ruleExplanation: Since 'had locked' happened before 'left' (also past), the past perfect stays the same in direct speech; only the pronoun reverses.
quests.nativeTip: Not every past perfect reverses — this one describes an action completed before another past action, so it stays as past perfect.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan said that he had locked the door before he left." ➔ "Hassan said, "I had locked the door before I left.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Chidinma said that she would call me later.
quests.reportedSpeech: Chidinma said, "I will call you later."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Would' reverses to 'will', 'she' reverses to 'I', and 'me' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Would' in reported speech usually reverses to 'will' in the original words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Chidinma said that she would call me later." ➔ "Chidinma said, "I will call you later.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Amir said that he could speak French.
quests.reportedSpeech: Amir said, "I can speak French."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Could' reverses to 'can', and 'he' reverses to 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the modal to its present form, along with the pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Amir said that he could speak French." ➔ "Amir said, "I can speak French.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said that we had to submit the assignment by Friday.
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said, "You have to submit the assignment by Friday."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' reverses to 'you', and 'had to' reverses to 'have to' since the teacher originally used present obligation.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse both the pronoun and the modal-like phrase 'had to' back to the teacher's original words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said that we had to submit the assignment by Friday." ➔ "The teacher said, "You have to submit the assignment by Friday.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Layla said that her brother had borrowed her car.
quests.reportedSpeech: Layla said, "My brother has borrowed my car."
quests.ruleExplanation: Both instances of 'her' reverse to 'my', and 'had borrowed' reverses to 'has borrowed'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse both possessives to match Layla as the original speaker.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Layla said that her brother had borrowed her car." ➔ "Layla said, "My brother has borrowed my car.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The twins said that their parents were proud of them.
quests.reportedSpeech: The twins said, "Our parents are proud of us."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Their' reverses to 'our', 'them' reverses to 'us', and 'were' reverses to 'are'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the possessive, the object pronoun, and the tense together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The twins said that their parents were proud of them." ➔ "The twins said, "Our parents are proud of us.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Omar told Yuna that he had seen her at the conference.
quests.reportedSpeech: Omar said to Yuna, "I saw you at the conference."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had seen' reverses to 'saw', 'he' reverses to 'I', and 'her' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: This past perfect reverses to simple past, and both pronouns switch back to first and second person.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Omar told Yuna that he had seen her at the conference." ➔ "Omar said to Yuna, "I saw you at the conference.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Priya said that she was leaving the next day.
quests.reportedSpeech: Priya said, "I am leaving tomorrow."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'The next day' reverses to 'tomorrow', 'was leaving' reverses to 'am leaving', and 'she' reverses to 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: 'The next day' reverses to 'tomorrow' in the original words.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya said that she was leaving the next day." ➔ "Priya said, "I am leaving tomorrow.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Julius said that he had arrived there the day before.
quests.reportedSpeech: Julius said, "I arrived here yesterday."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'There' reverses to 'here', 'the day before' reverses to 'yesterday', and 'had arrived' reverses to 'arrived'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the place word, the time word, and the tense together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Julius said that he had arrived there the day before." ➔ "Julius said, "I arrived here yesterday.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The manager said that the report was due that day.
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said, "The report is due today."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'That day' reverses to 'today', and 'was' reverses to 'is'.
quests.nativeTip: Two changes here: the time word and the verb tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said that the report was due that day." ➔ "The manager said, "The report is due today.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Fatima asked whether I liked spicy food.
quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima asked, "Do you like spicy food?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Liked' reverses to 'like', the auxiliary 'do' is added back, and word order becomes a question again; 'I' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the statement word order back into a question, and add the auxiliary 'do'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima asked whether I liked spicy food." ➔ "Fatima asked, "Do you like spicy food?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The officer asked whether I had a valid ticket.
quests.reportedSpeech: The officer asked, "Do you have a valid ticket?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had' reverses to 'do...have', and 'I' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse 'had' to its present form and rebuild the question with 'do'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The officer asked whether I had a valid ticket." ➔ "The officer asked, "Do you have a valid ticket?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Bashir asked whether they would attend the wedding.
quests.reportedSpeech: Bashir asked, "Will you attend the wedding?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Would' reverses to 'will', 'they' reverses to 'you', and inversion is restored.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the modal and the pronoun, then rebuild the question order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Bashir asked whether they would attend the wedding." ➔ "Bashir asked, "Will you attend the wedding?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: Camila asked where I had parked the car.
quests.reportedSpeech: Camila asked, "Where did you park the car?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Had parked' reverses to 'did park', and 'I' reverses to 'you'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the past perfect to past simple, add 'did', and rebuild the question.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Camila asked where I had parked the car." ➔ "Camila asked, "Where did you park the car?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The interviewer asked what my greatest weakness was.
quests.reportedSpeech: The interviewer asked, "What is your greatest weakness?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' reverses to 'your', and 'was' reverses to 'is'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the possessive and the tense, and restore the inverted question order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The interviewer asked what my greatest weakness was." ➔ "The interviewer asked, "What is your greatest weakness?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The coach asked why the players hadn't practiced harder.
quests.reportedSpeech: The coach asked, "Why didn't the players practice harder?"
changesList: statement word order → question word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Hadn't practiced' reverses to 'didn't practice', and inversion is restored.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the negative past perfect to a negative past simple question.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coach asked why the players hadn't practiced harder." ➔ "The coach asked, "Why didn't the players practice harder?""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The teacher told the students to close their books.
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said, "Close your books."
quests.ruleExplanation: 'To close' reverses to the imperative 'Close', and 'their' reverses to 'your'.
quests.nativeTip: Reverse the infinitive back into an imperative, and reverse the possessive pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher told the students to close their books." ➔ "The teacher said, "Close your books.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction
quests.directSpeech: The lifeguard warned the swimmers not to swim past the flags.
quests.reportedSpeech: The lifeguard said, "Don't swim past the flags."

quests.nativeTip: Reverse 'not to' back into the negative imperative 'don't'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The lifeguard warned the swimmers not to swim past the flags." ➔ "The lifeguard said, "Don't swim past the flags.""

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Indirect-to-Direct Reconstruction

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Selin asked her assistant to send the invoice that day." ➔ "Selin said, "Please send the invoice today.""

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Milo said that he had been working there for five years." ➔ "Milo said, "I have been working here for five years.""
